name: PVC Schedule 40 electrical conduit
description: Gray rigid PVC Schedule 40 conduit in 10ft lengths, solvent-welded; for underground and exposed runs, 1/2in to 1in. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: PVC specific gravity 1.40 ± 0.02 (ASTM D792), pvcpipesupplies.com PVC/CPVC physical properties sheet; Cantex safety data sheet gives 1.4-1.6 g/cm3. Weighed as solid material.

name: EMT conduit
description: Thin-wall steel electrical metallic tubing (EMT) in 10ft lengths with set-screw or compression fittings, for exposed indoor runs; 1/2in to 1in. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Steel density 7.85 g/cm3 (handbook). EMT weighs 30 lb per 100 ft at 1/2in (Wheatland EMT brochure, wall 0.042in), 46 lb at 3/4in and 67 lb at 1in (distributor tables).

name: THHN wire 12 AWG
description: Single-conductor 12 AWG copper THHN/THWN-2 building wire, pulled through conduit for 20A circuits. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Southwire THHN spec 10003: 12 AWG solid about 23 lb per 1000 ft, OD 0.12in; 10.4 kg over a 0.12in round x 1000 ft volume (0.00222 m3) = about 4,690 kg/m3.

name: THHN wire 10 AWG
description: Single-conductor 10 AWG copper THHN/THWN-2 building wire, pulled through conduit for 30A circuits. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Southwire THHN spec 10003: 10 AWG solid about 37 lb per 1000 ft (table text was garbled; stranded is 38-39 lb). Estimate: OD about 0.14in (0.102in conductor plus insulation and nylon jacket), giving about 5,550 kg/m3.

name: NM-B cable 14/2 with ground
description: Romex-type NM-B 14/2 with ground for dry indoor 15A lighting and outlet circuits, stapled to framing. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Southwire Romex SIMpull spec 10028: 14/2 W/G 61 lb per 1000 ft. Estimate: flat cable about 0.38 x 0.17in, giving about 2,180 kg/m3.

name: NM-B cable 12/2 with ground
description: Romex-type NM-B 12/2 with ground for dry indoor 20A circuits (kitchen, bath and outlet circuits). Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Southwire Romex SIMpull spec 10028: 12/2 W/G 87 lb per 1000 ft. Estimate: flat cable about 0.42 x 0.19in, giving about 2,520 kg/m3.

name: UF-B cable 12/2 with ground
description: Underground feeder UF-B 12/2 with ground, rated for direct burial and wet locations, for 20A circuits out to a pool house or outdoor outlet. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Southwire UF-B spec 10036 (13055955): 12/2 W/G 96-97 lb per 1000 ft. Estimate: flat cable about 0.44 x 0.20in, giving about 2,520 kg/m3.

name: Old-work electrical box (1-gang)
description: A single-gang PVC old-work (remodel) box with swing-out clamps, for adding an outlet or switch to a finished wall. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Carlon B114R-UPC: 0.125 lb (Elliott Electric) over 4-1/8 x 2-1/4 x 2-3/4in.

name: Weatherproof box with in-use cover
description: A weatherproof outdoor box with an in-use (bubble) cover, which NEC 406.9 requires for receptacles in wet locations. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 1 lb box and cover over a 6x4x4in envelope (not researched in this pass).

name: Duplex receptacle (15A)
description: An ordinary 15A duplex receptacle. Outdoors, in bathrooms and near a pool it needs GFCI protection, from a GFCI receptacle upstream or a GFCI breaker. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.1 lb over a 1.3x1.2x4.2in device (not researched in this pass).

name: GFCI receptacle (20A, weather-resistant)
description: A 20A weather-resistant GFCI receptacle; it protects itself and the outlets wired downstream of it. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.3 lb over a 1.75x1.5x4.2in device (not researched in this pass).

name: Exterior wall light (wet-location)
description: A wet-location rated exterior wall light, e.g. an LED lantern or wall pack beside a door. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 3 lb over a 12x8x6in envelope (not researched in this pass).

name: Recessed LED light (6in canless)
description: A 6in canless wafer LED downlight that clips into a ceiling hole and wires to a remote junction box; pick an IC-rated, wet-location one over a tub or in a damp room. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.6 lb over a 7.5x7.5x1in envelope (not researched in this pass).

name: Subpanel (100A)
description: A 100A load center fed from the main panel, e.g. to serve a pool house. Usually installed by a licensed electrician with a permit; the feeder size and grounding need a pro. Electrical work is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 20 lb over a 14.25x26x4in enclosure (not researched in this pass).
